item.title: Suspected pipe bombs found in Fort Washington Park, US Park Police say
item.description: An investigation is underway after several suspected pipe bombs were found in Fort Washington Park on Sunday, according to the U.S. Park Police.

item.title: Quadruple amputee cornhole player accused of shooting, killing man during argument in La Plata
item.description: A professional cornhole player is behind bars after he allegedly shot and killed someone during an argument on Radio Station Road in La Plata over the weekend, according to officials.

item.title: Dentist at Pure Dental Care accused of sexually assaulting patient in his office in Montgomery County
item.description: A dentist in Montgomery County was arrested after police investigated sexual offenses reported by patients. Detectives believe there may be additional victims.

item.title: UVA women's basketball advances to the Sweet Sixteen
item.description: The University of Virginia's women's basketball team is advancing to the Sweet Sixteen for the first time since 2000.

item.title: Installation of new bridge deck prompts I-66 lane closure in DC
item.description: ICYMI: Traffic on I-66 will be reduced to one lane in D.C. as crews install a new bridge deck. The lane closure started on March 24.

item.title: Two killed after BMW lands in trench during Rockville crash identified; driver hospitalized
item.description: Montgomery County police identified the two passengers killed in the Rockville crash on Sunday as Abraham D. Huracaya Del Aguila and Alexander J. Medrano Cangalaya.

item.title: Health alert issued for ground beef sold in 5 states and DC
item.description: Federal regulators are asking consumers in five states and the District of Columbia to check their freezers for possibly contaminated ground beef.

item.title: Man hogties partner, urinates on her while cutting off air with scarf during assault in DC
item.description: A 51-year-old man was found guilty for holding his romantic partner captive after an argument escalated, in which she escaped after being hogtied, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office in D.C.

item.title: Man faces 20 charges, linked to armed robberies targeting Arlington businesses: Police
item.description: A 19-year-old is facing 20 criminal charges after detectives linked him to four armed robberies in Arlington that targeted businesses.
